name: Isaxonine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1983 — for liver harm

summary: Isaxonine was taken off the market in France starting in 1983 because it caused damage to the liver [3]. In addition, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, evaluated the drug's risks [M]. This computer model gave the drug a low score of 34 for liver harm [M]. It also gave a low score of 15 for heart harm [M].
